fragments.rows: | inputlookup hindsight_findings | eval vuln_id=if(match(cve, "^CVE-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$"), cve, svd) | join type=left guid vuln_id [| inputlookup hindsight_exceptions_lookup | where status="active" AND (tonumber(expires)=0 OR tonumber(expires)>now()) AND asset!="*" | eval guid=asset, excepted_here=1 | fields guid vuln_id excepted_here] | join type=left vuln_id [| inputlookup hindsight_exceptions_lookup | where status="active" AND (tonumber(expires)=0 OR tonumber(expires)>now()) AND asset="*" | eval excepted_all=1 | fields vuln_id excepted_all] | eval excepted=if(isnotnull(excepted_here) OR isnotnull(excepted_all), 1, 0), vulnerable=if(hindsight_status="vulnerable", 1, 0)
fragments.hosts: | stats sum(eval(if(vulnerable=1 AND excepted=0 AND confidence="confirmed", 1, 0))) as confirmed sum(eval(if(vulnerable=1 AND excepted=0 AND confidence="possible", 1, 0))) as possible sum(eval(if(hindsight_status="unchecked", 1, 0))) as unchecked max(fit) as fit first(version) as version by guid | eval status=case(isnull(version) OR version="" OR version="unknown" OR unchecked>0, "Version unknown", confirmed>0, "Vulnerable", possible>0, "Possibly affected", true(), "Not affected")
fragments.cards: | stats count(eval(status="Vulnerable")) as vulnerable count(eval(status="Possibly affected")) as possible count(eval(status="Version unknown")) as unknown count(eval(status="Not affected")) as not_affected
